notes: rust-stdlib-crypto over getrandom (operating-system generator). Read panics where Go crashes on failure; Reader implements std::io::Read and reports system errors. Int and Prime use bigint::Int (this crate's non-negative integer) and crypto-primes' Baillie-PSW test; Int consumes the reader exactly as Go does, Prime follows Go's candidate shaping and honours the reader only with GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1 like Go 1.26+.

Int.note: None is Go's nil reader (the system source); a zero max panics; Go's reader argument becomes `rand::int_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go always honours the reader.

Prime.note: Go's reader argument becomes `rand::prime_with_rng`, which takes the reader first; the plain function uses the system source (ADR 0005). Go 1.26+ ignores the reader unless GODEBUG=cryptocustomrand=1.
